name: Entry Visa (eTAS Electronic Visa)

requirements.blocker_text: Since 1 September 2025, all foreign visitors must apply online through the eTAS electronic visa system before travelling to Somalia -- arriving without pre-approval is a hard bar under the new system.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for entry authorization at etas.gov.so before departure.

requirements.blocker_text: Passport must be valid for at least 6 months.
requirements.fix_path: Renew passport to meet the 6-month validity window.

evidence_required.document: Supporting documents depending on visa type

outcome.duration_length: not specified in sources located in this build -- category names (entry visa, extension, visa-on-arrival) are referenced but individual validity periods were not published on the agency's own site as retrieved

sources.title: Immigration and Citizenship Agency, Federal Republic of Somalia -- Visa Information: as of 1 September 2025 all foreign visitors must apply online in advance through the eTAS electronic visa system (etas.gov.so); general requirements listed as valid passport (6+ months), completed application form, and visa-type-dependent supporting documents; references entry visas, extensions, and visa-on-arrival without publishing individual duration/fee schedules

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Somalia). Published on tier-1 sourcing (the Immigration and Citizenship Agency's own site), but the site itself is unusually thin even by this dataset's standards -- it names visa categories (entry, extension, visa-on-arrival) without publishing per-category duration or fee figures, and the etas.gov.so application portal itself returned a 403 error on every fetch attempt in this build. This is disclosed as a genuine information gap, not filled with invented figures. POLITICAL CONTEXT, STATED PLAINLY AND CARRIED THROUGH EVERY FILE IN THIS BUILD: Somalia's Federal Government does not exercise uncontested control over its full territory -- Al-Shabaab controls or contests significant rural and some urban areas; Somaliland has functioned as a de facto independent, unrecognized state with its own passport, ID system, and laws since 1991; Puntland is a semi-autonomous federal member state. This dataset models the Federal Government of Somalia's own stated legal framework; whether it is administrable uniformly across Somali territory is a separate, unresolved question this build does not attempt to answer.
